scope: Additional thermal-source robustness, not an inferred total retention probability. All full-source masses and chronology come from final350. No new hydro, receiver spectrum or plant optimization.

criterion.enthalpy_interval_type: Two measured-material/isotope-scaled cases; not a subjective credible interval.
criterion.heat_partition: Conservative full incident gas kinetic energy percoremass. Local coating deposition, reflection, conduction, ablation and directional errors are separate.

population_bookkeeping: The finite-cap PDE fraction describes an already-mobile ideal channel population. It does not include prompt energetic backscatter, damaged pores, seams, source exhaust, or all thermal reemission.
The tabulated f is the TOTAL fraction of each full returnedH/He stream that becomes thermal cavitygas. An additional source should be added to the existing source, not substituted for it.
Additional thermal sources add linearly throughSigma=4R/A sum_i[q_i/(g_i vbar_i)]. Species-specific sources andcapturecan be supplied to steady_column().

A reflected energetic ion can cross the cavity and reimplant in another retained wall. It is not automatically a1000K gas particle; only its later thermal liberation contributes toq_i, with the appropriate delay.
Gas collected or held in a closed process loop remains station inventory. Heating and ionization alone do not receive removal credit.
Theg=.01/.03/.1 rows are effective physical cleanup requirements, not demonstrated pump operation. The warm cleanup field/beam-tail interface is still qualified separately.
Nitrogen andhydrocarbon chemistry use the separate frozen chemistry packet and are not silently included inH2/He.
model_limits: Steady uniform Maxwellian wallbalance is used even where gas collisions matter. Directed plumes or transport-limited localized pumps need spatial kinetics.

Chronological numbers assume instantaneous thermal release at the archived wall-arrival bins and a steady reservoir before the schedule starts. This is one explicit thermal-source history, not an upperbound on every possible plume.
Theg=.01/.1 chronology is rescaled from frozen cases. Oneg=.03 linear inventory response reuses the same archived arrivals; no fulltrace extraction or hydro is repeated.
The1st-percentile and slower2cm grains exceed the300K fullflightIR comparison without gas. Contained melting or protected delivery is an existing separate design branch.
Increasing grainradius affects source accelerationlength andhardware; these numbers do not preserve the previous stationrating automatically.
